password_policy.desc_zh: 至少 12 個字元的密語，不重複使用，存在密碼管理器，不寫在紙條上；新密碼會比對外洩密碼清單。
password_policy.desc_en: Passphrases of at least 12 characters, never reused, kept in the password manager and never written on notes; new passwords are checked against leaked-password lists.

session_lock.desc_zh: 螢幕幾分鐘沒動就鎖定，POS 和管理介面閒置 15 分鐘要重新登入；離開座位就鎖螢幕。
session_lock.desc_en: Screens lock after a few idle minutes, and POS or admin sessions ask for login again after 15 minutes idle; lock your screen when you walk away.

mfa_fatigue.desc_zh: 拿到密碼的攻擊者一直送驗證通知，直到受害者按下同意。
mfa_fatigue.notice_zh: 收到不是你自己發起的驗證通知。
mfa_fatigue.desc_en: An attacker with a stolen password floods the victim with MFA prompts until they approve one.
mfa_fatigue.notice_en: MFA prompts you did not start yourself.

phish_resistant_mfa.desc_zh: 通行金鑰或實體金鑰只在真正的網站有效，假網站或狂跳通知都騙不了；先用在管理者和服務台。
phish_resistant_mfa.desc_en: Passkeys or security keys only work on the real website, so a fake site or a flood of prompts cannot trick you; used first for admins and the help desk.

mfa.desc_zh: 登入除了密碼還要你擁有的東西，例如驗證 App；郵件、VPN、管理權限和刷卡環境都要。
mfa.desc_en: Logins need a password plus something you have, such as an authenticator app; required for email, the VPN, admin access and the card environment.

c_authentication.desc_zh: 證明身分的方式：你知道的（密碼）、你擁有的（手機、金鑰）、你本身的（指紋）。驗證是確認你是誰，授權是決定你能做什麼。
c_authentication.desc_en: Ways to prove identity: something you know (a password), something you have (a phone or key) and something you are (a fingerprint). Authentication proves who you are; authorization decides what you may do.

proc_unexpected_mfa.name_zh: 收到不是自己發起的多因素驗證通知
dont_zh: 不要為了讓通知停下來就按同意。
不要把手機上的驗證碼念給或按給打電話來的人，也不要照來電者給的號碼輸入。
proc_unexpected_mfa.time_en: Report right away: someone already has your password.
dont_en: Don't approve a prompt just to make it stop.
Don't read out a code from your phone, or type a number a caller gives you, for anyone who calls.
proc_unexpected_mfa.name_en: MFA prompts I did not start
proc_unexpected_mfa.time_zh: 馬上通報：有人已經拿到你的密碼了。

steps.text_zh: 不是你自己發起的通知，一律按拒絕。
steps.text_en: Deny every prompt you did not start yourself.

steps.text_zh: 打給資安監控中心（分機 2199）：有人知道你的密碼了。
steps.text_en: Call the SOC (ext. 2199): someone knows your password.

steps.text_zh: 用可信任的裝置重設密碼，登出所有工作階段。
steps.text_en: Reset your password from a trusted device and sign out all sessions.

steps.text_zh: 資安監控中心查登入嘗試來自哪裡，有沒有哪一次被同意了。
steps.text_en: The SOC checks where the sign-in attempts came from and whether any was approved.

steps.text_zh: 先讓所有推播登入（包括 VPN）都要號碼比對，再把帳號改成防釣魚的多因素驗證：通行金鑰或實體安全金鑰。
steps.text_en: Turn on number matching for every push sign-in, the VPN included, then move the account to phishing-resistant MFA: passkeys or security keys.

proc_lost_badge.time_en: Report as soon as you notice; Security blocks the badge at once.
dont_en: Don't wait until the next day.
proc_lost_badge.time_zh: 發現就通報；安全室會立刻停用。

steps.text_zh: 打給安全室（分機 1100，24 小時），說最後一次在哪裡、什麼時候還在。
steps.text_en: Call the Security desk (ext. 1100, 24/7) and say when and where you last had it.

steps.text_zh: 安全室立刻停用那張卡。
安全室查門禁紀錄，看遺失後有沒有被刷過。
steps.text_en: Security checks the access logs for any use of the badge after it was lost.

steps.text_zh: 核對身分後先給臨時證，再補發新卡。
steps.text_en: After checking your ID, Security gives you a temporary badge and then a new one.

steps.text_zh: 如果卡被別人用過，安全室和資安監控中心當成資安事件處理。
steps.text_en: If someone else used the badge, Security and the SOC treat it as a security incident.

story.intro_en: (A message from 23:40) You're the IT trainee on call tonight. Keep your work phone next to the bed. The crew copied the night-shift list, so if it goes off, it's probably them. Deny anything you didn't start, and the SOC is on 2199.
story.intro_zh: （晚上 11:40 的訊息）今晚你是資訊部的值班實習生，工作手機放床邊。歹徒抄走了夜班名單，手機要是響了，八成是他們。不是你發起的一律拒絕，資安監控中心是 2199。

title.hook_en: The party is over. At 03:10 your work phone lights up in the dark.
title.hook_zh: 派對結束了。凌晨三點十分，工作手機在黑暗中亮了。

rules.en: Your phone shows sign-in prompts, door alerts, calls and messages. A prompt you didn't start: swipe it off to the left to deny it.
rules.zh: 手機會跳出登入通知、門禁警報、電話和訊息。不是你發起的登入通知，往左滑掉就是拒絕。

rules.en: Signing in yourself? Type the number your laptop shows into the app on your phone.
rules.zh: 自己要登入時，把筆電上顯示的號碼輸入手機的 App。

rules.en: A caller is who they say only if you called them back on a number you already know. Dial it yourself: the SOC is 2199.
rules.zh: 打來的人，只有你用已知的號碼回撥確認過，才算是本人。自己撥號，資安監控中心是 2199。

rules.en: Someone at the Banquet Hall door? Hold the radio button on your laptop and tell Security. Approve the crew, type them a code or open a door for them three times, and the night is lost.
rules.zh: 宴會廳門口有人？按住筆電上的無線電按鈕告訴安全室。同意歹徒的登入、幫他們按驗證碼、幫他們開門，累計三次，今晚就輸了。

story.after_en: At 07:30 Jun-Hao meets you at the Security Policy Board in the corridor.
story.after_zh: 早上七點半，俊豪在走廊的資安政策公告欄前等你。

contacts.zh: 資安監控中心（24 小時）

console.radio_check_en: Security, this is IT on call. Just checking in.
console.radio_check_zh: 安全室，這裡是資訊值班，確認一下狀況。
console.radio_idle_en: Hsu here. All quiet on my side. Call me if the door camera shows anything.
console.radio_idle_zh: 許志明。我這邊很安靜，門口監視器有動靜再叫我。
console.reblock_en: Hsu here. Why is Kevin's badge active again? It was reported lost. I've blocked it.
console.reblock_zh: 許志明。凱文的卡怎麼又能用了？那張已經掛失了，我把它停用了。
console.soc_again_en: We're on it: your password is reset and every session is signed out. Go back to sleep.
console.soc_again_zh: 我們在處理了：你的密碼已經重設，所有工作階段都登出了。回去睡吧。

security.en: Security, Hsu. For the Banquet Hall door, use the radio on your door console; I hear it straight away.
security.zh: 安全室許志明。宴會廳門口的事，用門禁控制台上的無線電，我馬上就聽得到。

helpdesk.en: (recording) IT Help Desk. We're open from 07:00. For a security problem, call the SOC on 2199.
helpdesk.zh: （語音）資訊服務台，早上七點開始服務。資安問題請打 2199 找資安監控中心。

none.en: (recording) The number you dialled is not in service.

events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.ask_en: Someone at the Banquet Hall door got the code wrong. The party ended at 00:30. What do you do?
events.ask_zh: 有人在宴會廳門口按錯密碼。派對 00:30 就結束了。你要怎麼做？

options.en: Radio the Security desk to go and check
options.zh: 用無線電請安全室過去看看
options.radio_en: Hsu, someone is trying codes at the Banquet Hall door. Can you go and check?
options.radio_zh: 許大哥，有人在宴會廳門口試密碼，可以過去看一下嗎？
options.reply_en: Security, Hsu here. On my way to the Banquet Hall.
options.reply_zh: 安全室許志明，我現在過去宴會廳。

options.en: Unlock the door remotely to see who it is
Ignore it: probably a guest who got lost
options.zh: 不管它，大概是迷路的客人
options.why_en: A guest has no code to try. Someone who tries codes at 3 a.m. is worth a word to Security on the radio.
options.why_zh: 客人根本沒有密碼可以試。凌晨三點在試密碼的人，值得用無線電跟安全室說一聲。

beats.en: The door clicks open. Someone walks into the empty Banquet Hall.
beats.zh: 門喀一聲開了，有人走進空無一人的宴會廳。

beats.en: The event PC by the stage still has tonight's guest list open.
beats.zh: 舞台旁的活動電腦還開著今晚的賓客名單。

damage.hit_en: You opened a door for the crew

events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.name_zh: 資安監控中心 林俊豪
events.open_en: Hi, it's Jun-Hao from the SOC. We're seeing sign-in attempts on your account and I need to lock it now. I've sent a code to your phone: type it on your keypad and our system locks it.
events.open_zh: 你好，我是資安監控中心的俊豪。我們看到你的帳號一直有人在嘗試登入，我要馬上把它鎖住。我傳了一組驗證碼到你手機，在通話鍵盤上按出來，系統就會鎖住。
events.again_en: Ah, you called back. Good. Quick, type the code from the text on your keypad before they get in.
events.again_zh: 啊，你回撥了，很好。快，在他們進來之前，把簡訊裡的驗證碼在鍵盤上按出來。

push.en: Are you there? Just the six digits on your keypad.
push.zh: 你還在嗎？在鍵盤上按那六個數字就好。

push.en: Quick, they're getting in while we talk!
push.zh: 快一點，我們講話的時候他們就要進去了！

events.wrong_en: That didn't work. Type the code from the text again, carefully.
events.wrong_zh: 沒有成功。再按一次簡訊裡的驗證碼，仔細一點。

options.en: Hang up, and call the SOC yourself on 2199
options.zh: 掛掉，自己打 2199 給資安監控中心

options.why_en: Hanging up keeps the number safe. Calling 2199 yourself would also have told the real SOC.
options.why_zh: 掛掉，號碼就安全了。自己打 2199 的話，真的資安監控中心也會知道。

events.right_en: SOC, this is Jun-Hao. No, that wasn't me: I've been on the logs all night. Thanks for calling. Keep denying, we're on it.
events.right_zh: 資安監控中心，我是俊豪。沒有，那不是我，我整晚都在看紀錄。謝謝你打來。繼續拒絕，我們在處理了。

beats.en: "Jun-Hao" types 583 107 into the password-reset page and sets a new password. Your account opens on a PC outside Taiwan.
beats.zh: 「俊豪」在重設密碼的網頁輸入 583 107，設了新密碼，你的帳號在台灣以外的一台電腦上登入了。

beats.en: Your on-call account can open the door system and reset staff MFA.
beats.zh: 你的值班帳號可以操作門禁系統，也能重設員工的多因素驗證。

damage.hit_en: You gave the crew your sign-in

events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.alert_en: Banquet Hall door: correct code, waiting for a badge
events.alert_zh: 宴會廳門口：密碼正確，等待刷員工證
events.ask_en: This time the code was right. The door is waiting for a badge. What do you do?
events.ask_zh: 這次密碼對了，門在等員工證。你要怎麼做？

options.en: Tell Security the code is known, and keep the door locked
options.zh: 告訴安全室密碼外流了，門繼續鎖著
options.radio_en: They got the code right this time, so the code is out. The door stays locked; I'm not opening it.
options.radio_zh: 這次密碼按對了，密碼已經外流。門繼續鎖著，我不會開。
options.reply_en: Got it. I'm at the corridor now, staying by the door.
options.reply_zh: 收到，我到走廊了，會守在門口。

options.en: Unlock it remotely: whoever knows the code must be staff
options.zh: 遠端開門：知道密碼的應該是員工

options.en: Wait and see if a badge comes
options.why_en: The code is printed on posters in the corridor, so knowing it proves nothing. Tell Security now.
options.why_zh: 密碼就寫在走廊的海報上，知道密碼什麼也證明不了。現在就告訴安全室。

beats.en: You open the door. Nobody from the staff is there.
beats.zh: 你開了門，門口沒有任何一位員工。

beats.en: The cash box from the awards raffle is gone.
beats.zh: 頒獎晚會摸彩的錢箱不見了。

damage.hit_en: The code alone got them in, because you added the second factor for them
damage.hit_zh: 只靠密碼就進去了，因為第二道關卡是你幫他們開的

events.msg_en: Lakeside IT: we're fixing your sign-in. Approve the next request and these alerts will stop.
events.msg_zh: Lakeside 資訊部：我們正在修你的登入，同意下一則請求，這些通知就會停。
events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.alert_en: Banquet Hall door: badge #0417 (Kevin Wu) refused, badge blocked
events.alert_zh: 宴會廳門口：員工證 #0417（吳凱文）被拒，這張卡已停用
events.miss_en: The badge held, but nobody told Security, so the two of them walked off before anyone saw their faces.
events.miss_zh: 卡擋住了，可是沒人通知安全室，兩個人在被看到臉之前就走掉了。
events.ask_en: Kevin's badge was blocked at 22:50 after he lost it at the party. Someone is tapping it now. What do you do?
events.ask_zh: 凱文的員工證在派對上弄丟了，22:50 已經停用。現在有人在刷這張卡。你要怎麼做？

options.en: Keep it blocked, and tell Security someone is using Kevin's lost badge
options.zh: 維持停用，告訴安全室有人拿凱文遺失的卡在刷
options.radio_en: Someone is tapping Kevin's lost badge at the Banquet Hall door. The badge stays blocked. Can you get there?
options.radio_zh: 有人在宴會廳門口刷凱文遺失的那張卡。卡會維持停用，你可以過去嗎？
options.reply_en: I can see them: two people, heading for the car park. Calling the police.
options.reply_zh: 我看到了，兩個人往停車場走。我報警了。

options.en: Unblock it: maybe Kevin found his badge
options.zh: 解除停用：說不定凱文找到卡了

options.en: Call Kevin to ask whether it's him
options.why_en: Kevin is asleep and his badge stays blocked either way. Security needs to know now.
options.why_zh: 凱文在睡覺，那張卡怎樣都要維持停用。現在要讓安全室知道。

beats.en: The blocked badge works again. The door opens.
beats.zh: 停用的卡又能用了，門打開了。

beats.en: The crew plugs a small box into the network port behind the stage.
beats.zh: 歹徒在舞台後面的網路孔插上一個小盒子。

damage.hit_en: A lost badge opened the door again
damage.hit_zh: 遺失的員工證又開了門

events.ask_en: Security wants the camera recording kept. Sign in to the on-call portal on your laptop to lock the clip.
events.ask_zh: 安全室要把錄影留下來。用筆電登入值班入口，把那段影片鎖住。
events.where_en: On-call portal · your laptop · your room
events.where_zh: 值班入口・你的筆電・你的房間

events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

events.where_en: VPN sign-in · Windows PC · location unknown, outside Taiwan
events.where_zh: VPN 登入・Windows 電腦・位置不明，在台灣以外

report.en: I've had sign-in prompts I didn't start: someone has my password.
report.zh: 我一直收到不是我發起的登入通知：有人拿到我的密碼了。
report.ack_en: Then they have your password. I'm resetting it from here.
report.ack_zh: 那他們有你的密碼了，我這邊幫你重設。

report.en: Someone pretending to be Jun-Hao called from +44 7700 900417 and asked for the code on my phone.
report.zh: 有人冒充俊豪，從 +44 7700 900417 打來，要我給手機上的驗證碼。
report.ack_en: That wasn't me. Good that you didn't give it. I'm logging that number.
report.ack_zh: 那不是我。還好你沒給，我把那個號碼記下來。
report.ack_gave_en: That wasn't me. You typed him the code, so he's in: I'm signing out every session on your account right now.
report.ack_gave_zh: 那不是我。你把驗證碼按給他了，他已經進去了，我現在就把你帳號的所有工作階段登出。

report.en: I said yes to something I shouldn't have: a prompt, or the code he asked for.
report.zh: 我同意了不該同意的東西：一則登入通知，或是他要的驗證碼。
report.ack_en: Thanks for telling me straight away. That's what lets me cut them off.
report.ack_zh: 謝謝你馬上說，我才能把他們踢出去。

report.en: Someone tried the Banquet Hall door: the right code, then Kevin's blocked badge.
report.zh: 有人在試宴會廳的門：密碼對了，接著刷凱文停用的卡。
report.ack_en: I'll ask Security to stay at the Banquet Hall and pull the door log.
report.ack_zh: 我請安全室守在宴會廳，再調出門禁紀錄。

report.en: Can you turn MFA off on my account so the prompts stop?
report.zh: 可以把我帳號的多因素驗證關掉嗎？這樣通知就不會再跳了。
report.why_en: MFA is the only thing between the crew and your account tonight. Turning it off hands them the account.
report.why_zh: 今晚擋在歹徒和你帳號之間的就只剩多因素驗證，關掉等於把帳號交出去。

report.en: It's fine for now; I'll report it properly in the morning.
report.zh: 現在先這樣，我早上再正式回報。
report.why_en: The procedure says report right away: someone already has your password.
report.why_zh: 流程寫的是馬上通報：有人已經拿到你的密碼了。

beats.en: The crew signs in as you from 203.0.113.45.
beats.zh: 歹徒用你的帳號從 203.0.113.45 登入。

beats.en: Your on-call account can open the door system and reset staff MFA.
beats.zh: 你的值班帳號可以操作門禁系統，也能重設員工的多因素驗證。

push_damage.hit_en: You approved a sign-in you didn't start
push_damage.hit_zh: 你同意了不是你發起的登入

story.soc_reply_en: Thanks. The Help Desk is closed at night, so I'm resetting your password myself from a trusted device and signing out every session now. Go back to sleep; I'll see you at the corridor board at 07:30.
story.soc_reply_zh: 謝謝。服務台晚上沒開，我直接用可信任的裝置幫你重設密碼，把所有工作階段都登出。回去睡吧，七點半走廊公告欄見。

first.zh: 凌晨三點十分，工作手機亮了。

expired.en: It timed out. An unanswered prompt doesn't sign anyone in.
expired.zh: 時間到了。沒回應的通知不會讓任何人登入。

board.intro_en: Morning. Security pulled the door log and I pulled the sign-in logs. Three things to work out: how they got the door code, why the door stayed shut, and whose sign-in they got in the end.
board.intro_zh: 早安。安全室調出了門禁紀錄，我調出了登入紀錄。要搞清楚三件事：他們怎麼知道門禁密碼、門為什麼沒開、最後他們拿到了誰的登入。
board.intro_open_en: Morning. Security pulled the door log and I pulled the sign-in logs. Three things to work out: how they got the door code, what should have kept the door shut, and whose sign-in they got in the end.
board.intro_open_zh: 早安。安全室調出了門禁紀錄，我調出了登入紀錄。要搞清楚三件事：他們怎麼知道門禁密碼、本來是什麼該讓門鎖著、最後他們拿到了誰的登入。

sign.en: Staff Awards Night · MFA Door. The code is on the Security Policy Board: first the minimum password length, then the minutes before the POS logs you out. Then tap your staff badge.
sign.zh: 員工頒獎晚會・多因素驗證門。密碼就在資安政策公告欄上：先輸入密碼最少要幾個字元，再輸入 POS 閒置幾分鐘會登出。輸入後再刷員工證。

keeper.zh: 一夜 300 次 VPN 登入失敗。

door_log.title_zh: 宴會廳門禁控制器・03:00 到 03:30

rows.en: Code entered •••• · correct, waiting for a badge
rows.zh: 輸入密碼 •••• · 正確，等待刷卡

rows.en: Badge #0417 (Kevin Wu) · refused: blocked 22:50, reported lost
rows.zh: 員工證 #0417（吳凱文）· 拒絕：22:50 掛失停用

rows.en: Door held shut · alarm sent to the Security desk
rows.zh: 門維持上鎖 · 警報送到安全室

rows.en: Password correct · {n} prompts sent · all denied or timed out
rows.zh: 密碼正確 · 送出 {n} 則通知 · 全部拒絕或過期

rows.you_zh: 密碼正確 · 送出 {n} 則通知 · 你同意了 {a} 則

rows.zh: 密碼正確 · 送出 6 則通知 · 拒絕
密碼錯誤 · 試了 41 次 · 帳號鎖定

rows.zh: 密碼正確 · 通知被同意 · VPN 連線開始

rows.zh: 重設密碼：g.lin · 工單 INC-2207
重設密碼：bar-02 · 工單 INC-2207

rows.en: Reset password and MFA: k.wu · ticket INC-2207
rows.zh: 重設密碼和多因素驗證：k.wu · 工單 INC-2207

rows.en: Blocked badge #0417 (Kevin Wu), reported lost · ticket INC-2212
rows.zh: 停用員工證 #0417（吳凱文），掛失 · 工單 INC-2212

questions.en: Which four digits did the crew get right at 03:15? Type them on the keypad.
questions.zh: 03:15 歹徒按對的是哪四個數字？在鍵盤上輸入。
questions.how_en: The door sign says which two numbers make the code, and in which order. Find both on the posters.
questions.how_zh: 門牌寫了密碼是哪兩個數字、誰先誰後。到海報上把它們找出來。
questions.hint1_en: First number: the Passwords poster says how many characters at least. Second number: the Screen lock poster says after how many idle minutes the POS logs out.
questions.hint1_zh: 第一個數字：密碼海報上寫最少幾個字元。第二個數字：螢幕鎖定海報上寫 POS 閒置幾分鐘會登出。
questions.hint2_en: 12 from the Passwords poster, then 15 from the Screen lock poster.
questions.hint2_zh: 密碼海報上的 12，接著螢幕鎖定海報上的 15。
questions.solved_en: 1215: twelve from the password poster, and fifteen from the screen-lock poster, the minutes before the POS logs you out. Anyone who walks down this corridor can read it.
questions.solved_zh: 1215：密碼海報的 12，加上螢幕鎖定海報上 POS 閒置 15 分鐘登出的 15。走過這條走廊的人都看得到。

questions.en: The code was right. So why didn't the door open?
questions.zh: 密碼是對的，那門為什麼沒開？
questions.en_open: The code was right at 03:15. What should have kept the door shut, even without anyone on the console?
questions.zh_open: 03:15 密碼是對的。就算沒有人在控制台，本來是什麼該讓門維持鎖著？
questions.how_en: Pull the red string from this card to the line in the door log that shows what stopped them.
questions.how_zh: 把這張卡上的紅線拉到門禁紀錄裡、能看出是什麼擋住他們的那一行。
questions.how_open_en: The door log shows the console letting them in. Pull the red string from this card to the line that shows what still refused them after the right code.
questions.how_open_zh: 門禁紀錄裡看得到，是控制台放他們進去的。把這張卡上的紅線拉到密碼對了以後，他們還是被拒絕的那一行。
questions.how_accepted_en: The door log shows the console letting them in: Kevin's badge was unblocked before they tapped it. Pull the red string from this card to the line where that lost badge should have been refused.
questions.how_accepted_zh: 門禁紀錄裡看得到，是控制台放他們進去的：他們刷卡之前，凱文的員工證就已經解除停用了。把這張卡上的紅線拉到那張遺失的員工證本來應該刷不過的那一行。

options.en: It also wants something you have, and the badge they tapped was blocked at 22:50
options.zh: 門還要你擁有的東西，而他們刷的那張卡 22:50 就停用了

options.en: Security changed the code at midnight
options.why_en: The log says the code was accepted at 03:15. It was still the right code.
options.why_zh: 紀錄寫著 03:15 密碼被接受了，密碼並沒有換。

options.en: The keypad locks after two wrong tries
options.why_en: After the two wrong tries it still accepted the right code.
options.why_zh: 錯兩次之後，它還是接受了正確的密碼。

options.why_en: The alarm went off after the badge was refused, not before.
options.why_zh: 警報是在員工證被拒之後才響的，不是之前。

questions.evidence_en: Right. Now show me the line in the door log that proves it.
questions.evidence_zh: 對。在門禁紀錄裡指出能證明這件事的那一行。
questions.wrong_evidence_en: That line doesn't show what stopped them. Find the badge.
questions.wrong_evidence_zh: 那一行看不出是什麼擋住了他們，找員工證那一行。
questions.wrong_evidence_open_en: That line is the console letting them in. Find what still refused them: the badge.
questions.wrong_evidence_open_zh: 那一行是控制台放他們進去的紀錄。要找的是員工證被拒絕的那一行。
questions.wrong_evidence_accepted_en: That line is the console letting them in. Find the badge they tapped: it should have been refused.
questions.wrong_evidence_accepted_zh: 那一行是控制台放他們進去的紀錄。要找的是他們刷員工證的那一行，那張卡本來應該刷不過。
questions.solved_en: Two factors: something you know, which the crew read off a poster, and something you have, which was blocked because Kevin reported his lost badge.
questions.solved_zh: 兩種因素：你知道的，歹徒從海報上讀到了；你擁有的，因為凱文掛失了，那張卡被停用。
questions.solved_open_en: Two factors: something you know, which the crew read off a poster, and something you have, which was blocked because Kevin reported his lost badge. The second factor only works if nobody opens the door for them from the console.
questions.solved_open_zh: 兩種因素：你知道的，歹徒從海報上讀到了；你擁有的，因為凱文掛失了，那張卡被停用。第二道關卡要有用，前提是沒有人從控制台幫他們開門。

questions.en: Your phone held. Find the sign-in that let the crew in, and the change that gave them your password.
questions.zh: 你的手機守住了。找出讓歹徒進來的那次登入，還有讓他們拿到你密碼的那筆異動。
questions.how_en: Mark one line in the sign-in log and one in the account changes.
questions.how_zh: 在登入紀錄和帳號異動紀錄裡各標一行。
questions.en_you: Not every yes last night was Yi-Chen's. Find every sign-in that let the crew in, and the change that gave them your password.
questions.zh_you: 昨晚的同意不只易真那一次。找出所有讓歹徒進來的登入，還有讓他們拿到你密碼的那筆異動。
questions.how_you_en: Mark every sign-in that went through, and one line in the account changes.
questions.how_you_zh: 標出每一次成功的登入，再在帳號異動紀錄裡標一行。
questions.denied_en: Denied prompts are attempts that failed. Look for one that went through.
questions.denied_zh: 被拒絕的通知是失敗的嘗試，找一次成功的。
questions.wrong_en: Wrong passwords never reach a prompt. That account held.
questions.wrong_zh: 密碼錯誤根本不會送出通知，那個帳號守住了。
questions.cleanup_en: Those changes have tickets: that's Mei-Ling and Security cleaning up after dinner.
questions.cleanup_zh: 那幾筆都有工單，是美玲和安全室在晚餐後收拾殘局。
questions.missing_en: One more. How did they have your password at all? Look at who changed it, and when.
questions.missing_zh: 還差一個。他們怎麼會有你的密碼？看是誰改的、什麼時候。
questions.solved_en: 03:21: Yi-Chen approved one prompt to make them stop. And at 18:57 Kevin's stolen account reset your password with no ticket. That's how they had it.
questions.solved_zh: 03:21，易真為了讓通知停下來按了同意。18:57，被盜的凱文帳號在沒有工單的情況下重設了你的密碼，他們就是這樣拿到的。
questions.solved_you_en: Your yes let them in, and at 03:21 Yi-Chen approved one prompt to make them stop. At 18:57 Kevin's stolen account had reset your password with no ticket. That's how they had it.
questions.solved_you_zh: 你的同意讓他們進來了，03:21 易真也為了讓通知停下來按了同意。18:57，被盜的凱文帳號在沒有工單的情況下重設了你的密碼，他們就是這樣拿到的。

board.wrap_en: MFA held everywhere people denied the prompts and the lost badge was blocked. It failed once, when a tired person tapped Approve to make it stop.
board.wrap_zh: 大家拒絕通知、遺失的卡也停用了，多因素驗證就守住了。只失守一次：一個累了的人為了讓通知停下來，按了同意。
board.wrap_you_en: MFA held everywhere people denied the prompts and the lost badge was blocked. It failed where someone said yes to something they hadn't started, as Yi-Chen did at 03:21.
board.wrap_you_zh: 大家拒絕通知、遺失的卡也停用了，多因素驗證就守住了。失守的地方，都是有人同意了不是自己發起的東西，就像易真在 03:21 那樣。

case_uber.en: Almost tonight's script: a stolen password, prompt after prompt, then someone posing as IT saying to approve. One yes was enough, as with Yi-Chen at 03:21.
case_uber.zh: 幾乎就是今晚的劇本：密碼被偷，通知一則接一則，再來一個假冒資訊部的人叫你按同意。一次同意就夠了，就像易真在 03:21 那樣。

case_mgm.en: A phone call in someone else's name. Tonight the crew called you as the SOC.
case_mgm.zh: 一通冒用別人名字的電話。今晚歹徒冒充資安監控中心打給你。

board.next_en: 03:47. The night audit PC shows a ransom note.
board.next_zh: 凌晨三點四十七分，夜間稽核的電腦跳出勒索畫面。

ranks.line_en: Nothing you didn't start got a yes from you, and the door stayed shut.
ranks.line_zh: 不是你發起的，你一個都沒同意，門也一直鎖著。

ranks.line_en: Most of the night held. Next time, call 2199 the moment something feels off.
ranks.line_zh: 大部分都守住了。下次一覺得不對就打 2199。

ranks.line_en: Deny what you didn't start, never give a caller a code, and keep lost badges blocked.
ranks.line_zh: 不是你發起的就拒絕，驗證碼不給來電的人，遺失的卡維持停用。

cases.desc_zh: 一名跟 Lapsus$ 集團有關的攻擊者拿到外部承包商的密碼（多半是承包商自己的裝置中毒，密碼外流後被買走），接著一直送多因素驗證的推播。承包商一開始都拒絕；攻擊者就在 WhatsApp 上假冒 Uber 資訊部，叫他按同意，承包商就同意了一則。攻擊者從那裡碰到其他員工的帳號，以及 Slack、G Suite 等內部工具。
cases.lesson_zh: 推播登入要開號碼比對、改用防釣魚的多因素驗證，也要讓員工知道資訊部絕對不會叫人按同意。
cases.desc_en: An attacker linked to the Lapsus$ group had an external contractor's password, probably bought after malware on the contractor's own device exposed it, and kept sending MFA push requests. The contractor refused at first; the attacker then messaged on WhatsApp pretending to be Uber IT and said to accept, and the contractor approved one. From there the attacker reached other staff accounts and internal tools such as Slack and G Suite.
cases.lesson_en: Turn on number matching for push sign-ins, move to phishing-resistant MFA, and teach staff that IT never asks anyone to approve a prompt.

cases.desc_zh: 攻擊者在 LinkedIn 找到一名員工，打給服務台假冒他、取得重設後的權限；接下來的攻擊讓飯店和賭場系統（包括數位房卡和吃角子老虎機）停擺約十天，估計損失約 1 億美元。
cases.lesson_zh: 任何重設前都要核實來電者，特權帳號用防釣魚的多因素驗證，並準備人工替代方案。
cases.desc_en: Attackers found an employee on LinkedIn, called the IT help desk pretending to be that person and had access reset; the attack that followed disrupted hotel and casino systems, including digital room keys and slot machines, for about ten days, with an estimated impact of about US$100 million.
cases.lesson_en: Verify callers before any reset, use phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts, and prepare manual fallbacks.
